TOP: Tensorlake npm worm wipes machines on token revoke
Five critical Cisco Nexus flaws allow takeover
Oracle Health breach reaches nearly 20M people

P.h: Tensorlake npm worm wipes your machine if you revoke its token
P.p: tensorlake@0.5.144 steals developer credentials at install and plants a gh-token-monitor service that wipes the home directory if the stolen GitHub token is revoked. It was built from malicious commits pushed to main under a maintainer's name, so it carries a valid npm provenance attestation.
P.s: Pin to 0.5.143. Remove the service under ~/.config/gh-token-monitor/ before revoking any token, then rotate every credential the machine held.

items.h: Cisco warns of five critical Nexus NX-OS flaws
items.d: Remote code execution on Nexus switches when NX-API, Next Generation OAM or MPLS OAM are enabled. Disable them if unused and upgrade to a patched version.
Targets internet-facing LiteLLM, Ollama, Gotenberg, Gitea and possibly Ivanti Sentry. Mines Monero and hides C2 addresses in GitHub-hosted poetry.

items.h: Oracle Health breach tally nears 20 million
items.d: Stolen customer credentials opened a legacy Cerner server not yet migrated to Oracle Cloud. Attackers demanded crypto from hospitals.

items.h: AWS Strands Box sandboxes AI agents
items.d: Open source, OS-level containment with Dogwood policies on shell, network and MCP tools. Secrets are injected at an egress gateway so agents never see them.

P.h: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives at about 75% lower cost
P.p: Anthropic's fastest and cheapest small model targets high-volume work such as summaries, database queries and classification. It runs roughly 75% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 and is on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure.
P.s: Cache read prices for Sonnet 5.5 were halved, and Max and Team plans gain monthly API credits.

tiles.t: Should the agent look that up?

USDC and EURC across 89 payment corridors inside SAP Cloud ERP.
Temporal policies limit file deletions, API calls and Slack posts based on prior actions.

P.h: Kubelet watches inodes, just not until it is an emergency
P.p: Kubelet's image garbage collection only monitors disk bytes, so workloads heavy on small files get no early warning before pods are evicted. One build with @mui/icons-material consumed millions of inodes on a node.
P.s: A multi-stage Dockerfile cut an image from 40,000+ files to a few dozen. Alert on inode usage above 80% to catch it well before the 95% eviction threshold.

tiles.t: DNS root switched to KSK-2024 on Oct 11
tiles.d: DNSSEC resolvers without the new trust anchor can fail on healthy sites. Check with RFC 8509 sentinel queries.
OpenTelemetry, Kafka and Flink on 4 pods instead of 90 VMs.

Pair it with SAST and SCA.
